name: OSINT Dezinformácia Monitor — every 15 minutes
description: Continuous ingestion of Slovak RSS feeds for misinformation detection. Runs every 15 minutes.

name: High-Impact Misinfo Monitor — every 5 minutes
description: Rapid high-reach claim detection from high-profile Slovak political actors and disinformation hubs. Runs every 5 minutes.

name: Watchdog OSINT Full Pipeline — every 5 minutes
description: Full end-to-end OSINT watchdog pipeline: ingest -> translate -> classify -> visual triage -> fact-check -> graph update -> debunk delivery. Runs every 5 minutes.

name: Coordinated Debunk Engine — every 4 hours
description: Run deep debunk engine every 4 hours processing queued high-priority claims from high-impact-misinfo-monitor output.

name: Social Impact Accountability — 3× daily
description: Run stakeholder notification and accountability alerts 3× daily at 08:00, 14:00, 20:00 UTC. Requires SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS env vars for email delivery.

name: MSM Archive Audit — nightly 02:00
description: Nightly audit of Slovak mainstream media archives against documented outcomes. Runs at 02:00 UTC.
